method: Original physical rows, Euclidean translation and independently normalized quaternion dot-product angle; intervals from operation-end and first support-confirmation events.
hold_state_verification_scope: Peak hold-state labels are preserved declared evaluator labels; original raw physical evidence at each independently located peak is included for verification.

declared.interval_definition: reference_t <= sample_t <= operation_end_t; entire operation, including support handover
declared.sampling_scope: physical samples after fixed attempt reference; not control-rate maxima
declared.sample_count_definition: completed physical rows observed in the declared interval
declared.missing_sample_count_definition: observed rows lacking finite translation or rotation evidence; does not invent samples inside an evidence gap
declared.interpretation: relative cup-in-hand motion; support-handover motion is not automatically grasp failure

declared.interval_definition: reference_t <= sample_t < first support_transfer confirmation; if none, through operation_end_t

attempts.cadence_interpretation: Both rates use the identical fixed reference and operation intervals. Control endpoint times come from the sidecar, but values are recomputed from original physical rows. A physical-rate observed maximum may exceed a control-rate observed maximum.
